title: Adaptation to Environmental Change: Agriculture and the Unexpected Incidence of the Acid Rain Program
abstract: The Acid Rain Program (ARP) cut sulfur dioxide (SO2) emissions from power plants in the United States, with considerable benefits. We show this also reduced ambient sulfate levels, which lowered agriculture productivity through decreased soil sulfur. Using plant-level SO2 emissions and an atmospheric transport model, we estimate the relationship between airborne sulfate levels and yields for corn and soybeans. We estimate crop revenue losses for these two crops at around $1–$1.5 billion per year, with accompanying decreases in land value. Back-of-the-envelope calculations of the costs to replace lost sulfur suggest producer responses were limited and suboptimal. (JEL Q15, Q24, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 《酸雨计划》（ARP）削减了美国发电厂的二氧化硫（SO2）排放，带来了可观的效益。我们表明，这也降低了环境中的硫酸盐浓度，进而因土壤硫含量减少而降低了农业生产率。利用工厂层面的SO2排放数据和大气输送模型，我们估计了空气中硫酸盐浓度与玉米和大豆单产之间的关系。我们估计，这两种作物每年的收益损失约为10亿至15亿美元，并伴随着土地价值的下降。对替代损失硫元素成本的粗略测算表明，生产者的应对措施有限且并非最优。（JEL Q15, Q24, Q53, Q58）

title: High temperatures and electricity disconnections for low-income homes in California
Long-run pollution exposure and mortality: Evidence from the Acid Rain Program
abstract: Though over 90 percent of benefits from environmental quality improvements are attributed to long-term exposure, nearly all quasi-experimental evidence on the effects of pollution on health exploits changes in short-term exposure. Quantifying long-run exposure impacts requires a lasting, exogenous change in ambient pollution. Even if the initial change in pollution is exogenous, the long-run nature allows more time for economic agents to respond to changes in pollution, resulting in endogenous pollution exposure. We estimate the effects of long-run pollution exposure on mortality among adults by exploiting the United States Acid Rain Program (ARP) as a natural experiment. The ARP, which regulated emissions from coal power plants, created a permanent change in pollution across vast distances, enabling us to define broad treatment areas to subsume many potential confounding effects. We use a differenceindifferences design, comparing changes in mortality over time in counties "near" regulated plants to changes in mortality in similar counties "far" from the plants. We find relative mortality in treatment counties decreased after the introduction of the ARP, with mortality improvements growing steadily over time in both economic and statistical significance. The ARP had no significant effect on residential sorting or employment, helping rule out selection or economic mechanisms. Analysis by cause of death supports the role of fine particulate matter as the relevant pollutant.
abstract_zh: 尽管环境质量改善所带来的效益中，超过90%归因于长期暴露，但几乎所有关于污染对健康影响的准实验证据，都是利用短期暴露的变化。要量化长期暴露的影响，需要环境污染发生持久的、外生的变化。即使污染的初始变化是外生的，其长期性质也使经济主体有更多时间对污染变化做出反应，从而产生内生的污染暴露。我们以美国《酸雨计划》（ARP）作为自然实验，估计长期污染暴露对成年人死亡率的影响。ARP对燃煤电厂的排放进行了监管，在广阔的空间范围内造成了持久的污染变化，使我们能够界定较宽泛的处理区域，从而涵盖许多潜在的混杂效应。我们采用双重差分设计，比较受监管电厂“附近”县与远离电厂的相似县死亡率随时间的变化。我们发现，ARP实施后，处理县的相对死亡率下降，且死亡率改善的经济意义和统计显著性随时间稳步增强。ARP对居民分选或就业没有显著影响，这有助于排除选择性或经济机制的解释。按死因进行的分析支持细颗粒物是相关污染物这一作用。

title: Estimating causal effects of particulate matter regulation on mortality
abstract:
Estimating the causal effect of pollution on human health is integral for evaluating returns to pollution regulation, yet separating out confounding factors remains a perennial challenge.
We use a quasi-experimental design to investigate the causal relationship between regulation of particulate matter smaller than 2.5 micrograms per cubic meter (PM2.5) and mortality among those 65 years of age and older. We exploit regulatory changes in the Clean Air Act Amendments (CAAA). Regulation in 2005 impacted areas of the United States differentially based on pre-regulation air quality levels for PM2.5. We use county-level mortality data, extracted from claims data managed by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, merged to county-level average PM2.5 readings and attainment status as classified by the Environmental Protection Agency.
Based on estimates from log-linear difference-in-differences models, our results indicate after the CAAA designation for PM2.5 in 2005, PM2.5 levels decreased 1.59 micrograms per cubic meter (95% CI = 1.39, 1.80) and mortality rates among those 65 and older decreased by 0.93% (95% CI = 0.10%, 1.77%) in nonattainment counties, relative to attainment ones. Results are robust to a series of alternate models, including nearest-neighbor matching based on propensity score estimates.
This analysis suggests large health returns to the 2005 PM2.5 designations, and provides evidence of a causal association between pollution and mortality among the Medicare population.
abstract_zh:
估计污染对人类健康的因果效应，是评估污染规制收益的关键，但如何剥离混杂因素始终是一个长期存在的挑战。
本文采用准实验设计，考察细颗粒物（PM2.5，直径小于2.5微米的颗粒物）规制与65岁及以上人群死亡率之间的因果关系。我们利用《清洁空气法修正案》（CAAA）的规制变化作为识别来源。2005年的规制对美国各地区的影响存在差异，其依据是各地区在规制前的PM2.5空气质量水平。我们使用医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）管理的理赔数据提取县级死亡率数据，并将其与县级平均PM2.5读数以及美国环境保护署（EPA）划定的达标状态相匹配。
基于对数线性双重差分模型的估计结果表明，在2005年PM2.5被划定为不达标地区后，不达标县的PM2.5水平下降了1.59微克每立方米（95%置信区间为1.39至1.80），65岁及以上人群的死亡率相对于达标县下降了0.93%（95%置信区间为0.10%至1.77%）。在一系列替代模型中，包括基于倾向得分估计的最近邻匹配，结果均保持稳健。
本分析表明，2005年PM2.5划定规制带来了巨大的健康收益，并为医疗保险人群中污染与死亡率之间的因果关联提供了证据。

title: The impact of high ambient temperatures on delivery timing and gestational lengths
Maybe Next Month? Temperature Shocks and Dynamic Adjustments in Birth Rates
abstract: We estimate the effects of temperature shocks on birth rates in the United States between 1931 and 2010. We find that days with a mean temperature above 80°F cause a large decline in birth rates 8 to 10 months later. Unlike prior studies, we demonstrate that the initial decline is followed by a partial rebound in births over the next few months, implying that populations mitigate some of the fertility cost by shifting conception month. This shift helps explain the observed peak in late-summer births in the United States. We also present new evidence that hot weather most likely harms fertility via reproductive health as opposed to sexual activity. Historical evidence suggests that air conditioning could be used to substantially offset the fertility costs of high temperatures.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了1931年至2010年间美国气温冲击对出生率的影响。我们发现，日平均气温超过80°F的日子会在8至10个月后导致出生率大幅下降。与以往研究不同，我们证明最初的下降之后，接下来几个月出生人数会出现部分反弹，这表明人口会通过调整受孕月份来减轻部分生育成本。这种调整有助于解释美国观察到的夏末出生高峰。我们还提供了新的证据，表明炎热天气对生育的损害更可能是通过生殖健康途径，而非性行为途径。历史证据表明，空调可用于大幅抵消高温带来的生育成本。

title: Does Hot Weather Affect Human Fertility?
Adapting to Climate Change: The Remarkable Decline in the U.S. Temperature-Mortality Relationship over the 20th Century
abstract: Adaptation is the only strategy that is guaranteed to be part of the world's climate strategy. Using the most comprehensive set of data files ever compiled on mortality and its determinants over the course of the 20th century, this paper makes two primary discoveries. First, we find that the mortality effect of an extremely hot day declined by about 80% between 1900-1959 and 1960-2004.As a consequence, days with temperatures exceeding 90°F were responsible for about 600 premature fatalities annually in the 1960-2004 period, compared to the approximately 3,600 premature fatalities that would have occurred if the temperature-mortality relationship from before 1960 still prevailed. Second, the adoption of residential air conditioning (AC) explains essentially the entire decline in the temperature-mortality relationship. In contrast, increased access to electricity and health care seem not to affect mortality on extremely hot days. Residential AC appears to be both the most promising technology to help poor countries mitigate the temperature related mortality impacts of climate change and, because fossil fuels are the least expensive source of energy, a technology whose proliferation will speed up the rate of climate change.
abstract_zh: 适应是世界气候战略中唯一一定会被纳入的策略。本文利用迄今为止汇编的、关于20世纪死亡率及其决定因素的最全面数据文件，得出两项主要发现。第一，我们发现，极端炎热日的死亡效应在1900—1959年至1960—2004年间下降了约80%。因此，在1960—2004年期间，气温超过90°F的日子每年导致约600例过早死亡，而如果1960年以前的气温-死亡率关系仍然存在，则约会导致3600例过早死亡。第二，住宅空调的普及几乎完全解释了气温-死亡率关系的全部下降。相比之下，电力和医疗服务可及性的提高似乎并未影响极端炎热日的死亡率。住宅空调似乎既是帮助贫穷国家减轻气候变化所带来的与气温相关死亡影响的最有前景的技术，同时，由于化石燃料是最廉价的能源来源，这项技术的普及也将加快气候变化的速度。

title: Heaping-Induced Bias in Regression Discontinuity Designs
abstract: This study uses Monte Carlo simulations to demonstrate that regression-discontinuity designs arrive at biased estimates when attributes related to outcomes predict heaping in the running variable. After showing that our usual diagnostics are poorly suited to identifying this type of problem, we provide alternatives. We also demonstrate how the magnitude and direction of the bias varies with bandwidth choice and the location of the data heaps relative to the treatment threshold. Finally, we discuss approaches to correcting for this type of problem before considering these issues in several non-simulated environments.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用蒙特卡洛模拟表明，当与结果相关的个体特征能够预测驱动变量中的堆积现象时，断点回归设计会得到有偏的估计结果。在说明我们常用的诊断方法难以识别此类问题之后，我们提供了替代方法。我们还展示了偏误的大小和方向如何随带宽选择以及数据堆积点相对于处理阈值的位置而变化。最后，在考虑几个非模拟环境中的这些问题之前，我们讨论了纠正此类问题的方法。

title: Success is Something to Sneeze At: Influenza Mortality in Cities that Participate in the Super Bowl
abstract: Using county-level Vital Statistics of the United States data from 1974 to 2009, we employ a differences-in-differences framework comparing influenza mortality rates in Bowl-participating counties to nonparticipants. We estimate having a local team in the Super Bowl caused an 18 percent increase in influenza deaths for the population over age 65. Results are most pronounced in years when the dominant influenza strain is more virulent, or when the Super Bowl occurs closer to the peak of influenza season. We find no impacts on influenza mortality in hosting cities. Our findings suggest mitigating transmission at gatherings related to large spectator events could have substantial returns for public health.

title: A Pint for a Pound? Minimum Drinking Age Laws and Birth Outcomes
Convergence in Adaptation to Climate Change: Evidence from High Temperatures and Mortality, 1900-2004
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings
abstract: This paper combines panel data on monthly mortality rates of US states and daily temperature variables for over a century (1900-2004) to explore the regional evolution of the temperature-mortality relationship and documents two key findings. First, the impact of extreme heat on mortality is notably smaller in states that more frequently experience extreme heat. Second, the difference in the heat-mortality relationship between hot and cold states declined over 1900-2004, though it persisted through 2004. Continuing differences in the mortality consequences of hot days suggests that health motivated adaptation to climate change may be slow and costly around the world.
abstract_zh: 本文将美国各州1900至2004年间超过一个世纪的月度死亡率面板数据，与逐日温度变量相结合，以探讨温度与死亡率关系的区域演变，并记录了两项关键发现。第一，在更频繁经历极端高温的州，极端高温对死亡率的影响明显更小。第二，炎热州与寒冷州之间在高温—死亡率关系上的差异，在1900至2004年间有所下降，但直至2004年仍然存在。炎热日子对死亡率影响的持续差异表明，出于健康动机的气候变化适应在全球范围内可能进展缓慢且成本高昂。

title: Absolute Humidity, Temperature, and Influenza Mortality: 30 Years of County-Level Evidence from the United States
abstract: Recent research exploring associations between environmental factors and influenza outcomes has devoted substantial attention to the role of absolute humidity. However, the existing literature provides very little quantitative epidemiologic evidence on the relations between absolute humidity and other weather variables and influenza outcomes in human populations. In the present study, the authors helped fill this gap by analyzing longitudinal weather and influenza mortality data, observed every month between January 1973 and December 2002, for each of 359 urban US counties. A flexible regression model was used to simultaneously explore fully nonlinear relations between absolute humidity and influenza outcomes and temperature and influenza outcomes. Results indicated that absolute humidity was an especially critical determinant of observed human influenza mortality, even after controlling for temperature. There were important nonlinear relations; humidity levels below approximately 6 g of water vapor per kilogram of air were associated with increases in influenza mortality. Model predictions suggested that approximately half of the average seasonal differences in US influenza mortality can be explained by seasonal differences in absolute humidity alone. Temperature modestly influenced influenza mortality as well, although results were less robust.
abstract_zh: 近期探讨环境因素与流感结局之间关联的研究，对绝对湿度的作用给予了大量关注。然而，现有文献几乎没有提供关于绝对湿度及其他天气变量与人群流感结局之间关系的定量流行病学证据。在本研究中，作者通过分析1973年1月至2002年12月期间，美国359个城市县每月观测的纵向天气与流感死亡数据，填补了这一空白。我们采用灵活的回归模型，同时考察绝对湿度与流感结局、以及温度与流感结局之间的完全非线性关系。结果表明，即使在控制温度之后，绝对湿度仍是观测到的人群流感死亡的一个尤为关键的决定因素。两者之间存在重要的非线性关系：空气中水蒸气含量低于约每千克空气6克时，与流感死亡增加相关。模型预测表明，美国流感死亡平均季节性差异中，约一半仅由绝对湿度的季节性差异即可解释。温度对流感死亡也有一定影响，但结果的稳健性较弱。

title: Agricultural Policy, Migration, and Malaria in the United States in the 1930s
abstract: The Agricultural Adjustment Act (AAA) caused a population shift in the United States in the 1930s.Evaluating the effects of the AAA on the incidence of malaria can therefore offer important lessons regarding the broader consequences of demographic changes. Using a quasi-first difference model and a robust set of controls, we find a negative association between AAA expenditures and malaria death rates at the county level. Further, we find the AAA caused relatively low-income groups to migrate from counties with high-risk malaria ecologies. These results suggest that the AAA-induced migration played an important role in the reduction of malaria.
abstract_zh: 《农业调整法》（AAA）在20世纪30年代引发了美国的人口迁移。因此，评估该法对疟疾发病率的影响，可以为理解人口结构变化的更广泛后果提供重要启示。利用准一阶差分模型和一套稳健的控制变量，我们发现在县级层面，AAA支出与疟疾死亡率之间存在负相关关系。此外，我们发现AAA促使相对低收入群体从疟疾高风险生态区的县迁出。这些结果表明，AAA引发的人口迁移在降低疟疾发病率方面发挥了重要作用。

title: Saving Babies? Revisiting the Effect of Very Low Birth Weight Classification
The Long-Term Economic Impact of In Utero and Postnatal Exposure to Malaria
abstract: I use an instrumental-variables identification strategy and historical data from the United States to estimate the long-term economic impact of in utero and postnatal exposure to malaria. My research design matches adults in the 1960 Decennial Census to the malaria death rate in their respective state and year of birth. To address potential omitted variables bias and measurement-error bias, I use variation in "malaria-ideal" temperatures to instrument for malaria exposure. My estimates indicate that in utero and postnatal exposure to malaria led to considerably lower levels of educational attainment and higher rates of poverty later in life.
abstract_zh: 我利用工具变量识别策略和来自美国的历史数据，估计子宫内及出生后暴露于疟疾的长期经济影响。我的研究设计将1960年十年一次人口普查中的成年人，与其出生所在州和出生年份的疟疾死亡率进行匹配。为解决潜在的遗漏变量偏误和测量误差偏误，我使用“疟疾理想”温度的变化作为疟疾暴露的工具变量。我的估计表明，子宫内及出生后暴露于疟疾，导致成年后的受教育程度显著降低，贫困率显著升高。
